name: Amakano+
source:
This is the fandisc for Amakano, with two episodes for each of the three heroines: a summer episode and a future episode culminating in marriage. It also includes other mini bonuses, like special commemorative voices and desktop accessories. Each heroine will get 5 H scenes.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《Amakano》的粉丝碟，为三名女主角各收录两个章节：夏日篇，以及最终步入婚姻的未来篇。还包含特别纪念语音、桌面装饰等迷你特典。每名女主角都有5个H场景。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
